Team.title: Team
Team.subtitle: Admin accounts and what each one can reach.
Team.addDescription: This is the only way a new admin account gets created — there's no public sign-up anymore. Share the generated password over a secure channel.

roleDescriptions.MANAGER: Everything: prices, discounts, the team, and every quotation.
roleDescriptions.SALES: Creates and sends quotations, and follows orders. Sees only the quotations they own.
roleDescriptions.ENGINEERING: Products, specs, categories and datasheets. Reads every quotation to review it, without editing.
roleDescriptions.ACCOUNTS: Orders, customers and stock. Reads every quotation, without editing.
